description: FormVox dependency updates (npm + composer). Runs on a schedule via .forgejo/workflows/renovate.yml; the fast ci.yml gate + integration matrix validate each update branch.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major npm devDependencies into one PR to cut noise.
Group all non-major composer dev deps together.
Major bumps get their own PR — they usually need review + code changes.
Pin the test-only NC OCP stubs to the lowest supported server (stable32); don't let Renovate chase a newer branch.
Psalm must stay on 5.x (6 needs PHP >=8.4, our CI floor is 8.2). Only patch/minor within 5.
Stryker needs Node >=22; keep it on the current major line.
